rule.en:
Most nouns add **-s** for more than one: a dog → **dogs**, a lamb → **lambs**. **the** stays the same; **a** has no plural: **a dog** → **dogs**.

After s, x, ch, sh add **-es**: box → **boxes**, bench → **benches**, bush → **bushes**. A consonant + **y** becomes **-ies**: pony → **ponies**, berry → **berries** (a vowel + y just adds -s: day → **days**). Some words in **-f** or **-fe** end in **-ves**: knife → **knives**, loaf → **loaves**, leaf → **leaves** (but roof → **roofs**).

A few plurals are irregular; learn them: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**, foot → **feet**, tooth → **teeth**, mouse → **mice**.

Some stay the same: **one sheep, fifty sheep**; **one fish, two fish**; **a deer, three deer**.

From two on, the noun is plural, also for measures: **two miles**, **three hours**, **ten pounds**.
rule.sl:
Večina samostalnikov dobi v množini **-s**: a dog → **dogs**, a lamb → **lambs**. Člen **the** ostane enak, **a** pa v množini odpade: **a dog** → **dogs**.

Za s, x, ch, sh dodamo **-es**: box → **boxes**, bench → **benches**, bush → **bushes**. Soglasnik + **y** postane **-ies**: pony → **ponies**, berry → **berries** (samoglasnik + y dobi le -s: day → **days**). Nekatere besede na **-f** ali **-fe** se končajo na **-ves**: knife → **knives**, loaf → **loaves**, leaf → **leaves** (toda roof → **roofs**).

Nekaj množin je nepravilnih, zapomni si jih: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**, foot → **feet**, tooth → **teeth**, mouse → **mice**.

Nekatere se ne spremenijo: **one sheep, fifty sheep**; **one fish, two fish**; **a deer, three deer**.

Lažje kot v slovenščini: dvojine ni in oblika se ne spreminja s številom (dve ovci, tri ovce, pet ovc). Od dve naprej je vedno ista množina: **two miles**, **five miles**.
rule.it:
La maggior parte dei nomi al plurale aggiunge **-s**: a dog → **dogs**, a lamb → **lambs**. **the** resta uguale (i, gli, le: sempre **the**), **a** al plurale sparisce: **a dog** → **dogs**.

Dopo s, x, ch, sh si aggiunge **-es**: box → **boxes**, bench → **benches**, bush → **bushes**. Consonante + **y** diventa **-ies**: pony → **ponies**, berry → **berries** (vocale + y prende solo -s: day → **days**). Alcune parole in **-f** o **-fe** finiscono in **-ves**: knife → **knives**, loaf → **loaves**, leaf → **leaves** (ma roof → **roofs**).

Alcuni plurali sono irregolari, da imparare: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**, foot → **feet**, tooth → **teeth**, mouse → **mice**.

Alcune parole non cambiano, come il caffè, i caffè: **one sheep, fifty sheep**; **one fish, two fish**; **a deer, three deer**.

Da due in su il nome è al plurale, anche con le misure: **two miles**, **three hours**, **ten pounds**.
rule.de:
Die meisten Nomen bekommen im Plural **-s**: a dog → **dogs**, a lamb → **lambs**. Viel einfacher als im Deutschen: meist kein Umlaut und kein -e, -er oder -en zum Lernen. **the** bleibt gleich (die: **the**), **a** fällt weg: **a dog** → **dogs**.

Nach s, x, ch, sh kommt **-es**: box → **boxes**, bench → **benches**, bush → **bushes**. Konsonant + **y** wird **-ies**: pony → **ponies**, berry → **berries** (Vokal + y bekommt nur -s: day → **days**). Manche Wörter auf **-f** oder **-fe** enden auf **-ves**: knife → **knives**, loaf → **loaves**, leaf → **leaves** (aber roof → **roofs**).

Einige Plurale sind unregelmäßig, lerne sie: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**, foot → **feet**, tooth → **teeth**, mouse → **mice**.

Manche bleiben gleich, wie der Lehrer, die Lehrer: **one sheep, fifty sheep**; **one fish, two fish**; **a deer, three deer**.

Ab zwei steht das Nomen im Plural, auch bei Maßen, anders als bei zwei Kilo, zehn Euro: **two miles**, **two kilos**, **ten pounds**.
